metaDescription: Free online Board Foot Calculator. Calculate board feet of lumber.
intro: Use our free online Board Foot Calculator tool. It calculates lumber volume based on your inputs.
whatIs: The Board Foot Calculator is an online utility that calculates lumber volume. It processes your thickness and provides total board feet (BF).
howToUse: Enter your thickness into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like width/length.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate total board feet (BF).
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your thickness. It instantly processes the data to output total board feet (BF).
workedExample: For example: A 2"x6"x12' board contains 12 board feet.
resultInterpretation: The result represents total board feet (BF). You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing thickness on the go
tipsAndLimitations: Hardwood is sold by volume (BF), not linear length.
Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: What is one board foot?
faq.answer: A piece of wood 12" x 12" x 1" thick.
